items.briefing:
Interpol has activated a global system to intercept fraudulent payments before they reach scammers, which could benefit Australians who fall victim to payment fraud. Separately, a new AI-powered email security tool called Doppel detected a Japanese-language phishing campaign on its very first day in operation, highlighting how AI is increasingly being used both by attackers and defenders.

Research is also flagging a growing gap in AI governance — many organisations are deploying AI without proper oversight or policies in place. If your organisation uses AI tools, make sure there are clear guidelines about what data staff can share with them.
